original_source.original_code: sjjy_data/generate_graph.py strips ROUND and exports relations.csv
original_source.prior_reference: Su & Hu 2019, https://doi.org/10.1140/epjds/s13688-019-0192-x, same variable labels on similarly described Chinese dating service; EXACT dataset overlap UNPROVEN because paper 4.151m vs SSJY 8.599m events.

A.question: Do recommended-candidate opportunities actually support observed click and message actions within the same actor-target-round, and, conditional on the recorded offered slate, is post-recommendation clicking more concentrated among target users with a higher previous click-through score measured on disjoint actor training data?
A.population: Author-shared SSJY Chinese heterosexual dating-site platform historical trace, unverified representativeness and exact year; recorded rec events, not all possible eligible pairs nor physical actual viewing confirmation.
A.unit: Unique (actor,target,ROUND) recommended pair. A recorded rec indicates platform generated/presented candidate under original related article, NOT known rendered impression or attended/viewed profile.
A.primary_estimand: Out-of-actor-sample log loss of click occurrence on a unique rec triple; compare source-informed target historical click-through baseline to a common within-round baseline. Prognostic prediction, NOT causal effect of recommendation.
primary_metrics: Covered fraction of click/msg action triples having matching rec triple in same actor/target/round
Out-of-actor-heldout logloss improvement over common per-round historical rate
Within-slate target popularity ranking AUC conditional on slate having both clicked and nonclicked candidates; if feasible
A.harm: Never print or upload any raw source IDs, profiles, demographics, videos or rows.

B.H1: Historical target-specific click-through propensity, estimated only from other actors' training slates, improves out-of-user click prediction conditioned on offered candidate, beyond global click rate and actor-round opportunity set size.
B.H0: Historical target-specific response rates do not improve out-of-actor logloss; exposure composition alone plus slate-level click incidence is enough for predictions.
B.H_alt: Algorithm ranks candidates nonrandomly on latent desirability, cross-actor homophily/attributes, missing sessions and feedback; any predictive gain is not unique to ESBM nor identified cause. No explicit no or relationship outcome.

C.split: Assign actors to train/heldout via sha256 stable 80/20 hash of int actor id and fixed SALT; disjoint IDs, NEVER tune to heldout. Report actor counts/events, not individual IDs.
C.unit_construction: Deduplicate all rec for actor,target,ROUND; label=1 if at least one click in same triple. Also mark message same triple; don't count other round as same. Events without same-round rec audited separately and cannot be imputed as refusals. Only rec triples form risk set. ROUND is actor-specific ordinal session/round, not calendar time; no causal or sequential between actors.
C.features: Train-only target stats: unique rec triples and unique rec triples with click; empirical Bayes Laplace smoothed target CTR (click_count+alpha*p_train)/(rec_count+alpha), alpha=20 fixed. All target counts computed from train actors only. Target unseen default train global CTR; avoid target actor leakage. Simple baseline global CTR from train (constant). Secondary slate-aware model can stratify round-size bins, but must not use test labels for predictions.
C.comparison: Primary heldout per-triple logloss of target CTR vs global CTR (equal sample), also Brier, difference and cluster uncertainty. This conditions on actually recorded rec offers and holds out actors; source's own popularity/CTR benchmark is stronger prior art, this is not claim of novelty.
C.repeated: Risk-set counts by distinct dyad-round; report repeat recommended same actor-target over rounds and click incidence first versus later descriptively only (conditional on selected repeated dyads, no causal inference).
C.uncertainty: Cluster bootstrap heldout actors B=100 seed=20261029 for difference in per-offer logloss; as all rows of one actor move together, no independence claim for repeated rec rows; report percentile 2.5–97.5% CI. Null consistent no benefit if interval spans zero. Efficiency: preaggregate user-level logloss sums and resample actor groups, no huge raw bootstrap.
QA: Check raw counts rec/click/msg against N81 source action counts
Check percentage action matching rec same triple vs ever rec different round
Round nonnegative integer and max/number sessions
No future target information from heldout user, no leakage
No exploratory hyperparameter selection on heldout
No pickle or embedded database code executed
C.multiplicity: Only logloss improvement against global train rate is primary; Brier and repeat effects descriptive secondary; no multiple testing claims beyond primary.

D.instrument: Independent Python code will be committed to same branch and sha256 computed before any aggregate summaries. Read zipped 190MB original text in pandas; avoid raw ID printing. Aggregate-only outputs and QA, no network, no data rehosting. Reproduce local source code SHA and dataset SHA; clean clone not claimed.
D.rights: Original author GitHub says ZIP publicly downloadable; no separate license found in repo or ZIP; analyze local minimally, publish only nonidentifying aggregate, verify rights before redistributing.

Round is actor/session index not calendar wall clock
Different target users may share original account identity? original anonymized IDs only
Repeated recommendations not independent of past click and target popularity feedback
Target-history only training actor out-split not chronological prior to holdout; cannot call 'previous' in real time. Rephrase train-group historical cross-sectional target CTR
Train/test as stored in MotifGNN are constructed from graph and should not be recycled as independent baseline

G.external_validation: Disjoint actor holdout within same platform, not independent external cohort. No second platform available. Original source paper Su/Hu 2019 may share original operator; not independent without provenance.

H.source_and_prior_plan: Add original 2019 paper as new source distinct publication but dataset potential overlap with SSJY SRC059; revise P-OPPORTUNITY, P-ACTION-SEMANTICS, P-DYADIC_ACCESS and P-NOVELTY with NO_CHANGE_WITH_REASON if needed, source/priors/updates append-only.

I.CT2_after: To decide; no automatic increase; grade 0/3 barring independently novel validated effect.

J.decision: Count N82 valid only if code and complete data QA plus primary out-of-actor contrast and adversarial decision documented; else do not consume, STOP_R5. Either way stop causal ESBM validation without true exposure confirmations, explicit declines, temporal relationships.

DRIFT.rationale: Same mating-platform dyadic action paradigm with newly recovered source event-grain (user-target-round), moving from unconditional graph topology to opportunity-conditioned choice prediction. No new domain.
